section: DetailPanel — Info card detail rows (label column)
description: Each detail row is a flex row (no flex-wrap) with a fixed 110px label column (width:110, minWidth:110) plus icon + gaps. At a ~250px panel (minus 32px padding) the rigid 110px label leaves almost no room for the value, crowding the wrapping value column. The minWidth:110 prevents the label from shrinking on small screens.
currentCode: {icon} {label} {val || "—"}
suggestedFix: Allow the row to stack at narrow widths and let the label shrink. Add flexWrap:"wrap" to the row and replace the fixed label width with a responsive basis, e.g. label span: style={{ flexBasis: 110, minWidth: 80, flexGrow: 0, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 600, color: "#9ca3af", paddingTop: 1 }} — or add a media query @media(max-width:360px){ .detail-row{flex-direction:column;gap:2px} .detail-row .lbl{width:auto;min-width:0} }

description: Same rigid 110px label column (width:110, minWidth:110) inside a non-wrapping flex row holding icon + label + value; at narrow panel widths the value (date + time) is crowded and cannot reclaim space because the label cannot shrink.
currentCode: 🗓️ Submitted {fmt(item.createdAt)} {fmtTime(item.createdAt)}
suggestedFix: Add flexWrap:"wrap" to the row and make the label flexible: replace width:110, minWidth:110 with flexBasis:110, minWidth:80, flexGrow:0 on the label span so it can shrink at narrow widths.

description: A 500px font-size glyph is rendered absolutely; it is wrapped in an overflow:hidden full-bleed layer so it does not itself cause horizontal scroll, but on a 250px viewport the giant fixed glyph is visually oversized. The fixed 500px font-size does not scale down on small screens.
suggestedFix: Use a viewport-relative size that shrinks on small screens, e.g. fontSize: "min(500px, 90vw)" so the watermark scales down below 250px while keeping the desktop size.
